boardStatus: ABIM has a Rheumatology Certification Examination. “Advanced Rheumatology Fellowships” is not a separately named ABIM certification, subspecialty examination or additional board.
boardEligibilityNotice: ABIM states that rheumatology certification requires prior ABIM Internal Medicine certification, completion of accredited fellowship training, documented competence, a valid unrestricted/un-challenged medical license and passing the examination. Training must be ACGME, Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, or Collège des médecins du Québec accredited. ABIM lists 24 months total training and 12 clinical months, plus specified aspiration/microscopy and injection procedures. An online course, public videos, research time alone, observation or a clinical rotation cannot be substituted or double-counted. The separate ABIM/ABAI combined rheumatology–allergy/immunology pathway requires prospectively approved three-year combined training; no claim is made that Johns Hopkins offers it.

boardStatus: ABAI is an ABMS member board. ABAI’s public Certification Examination is a separate, secure, annual computer-based examination (225 items; 7 hours; approximate 25% basic science/75% clinical science). The course is neither endorsed by ABAI nor a board-review course.
boardEligibilityNotice: This independent course creates no eligibility. ABAI publicly requires, among other items, ABIM and/or ABP specialty certification by the examination date; at least 24 consecutive months of full-time qualifying Allergy/Immunology fellowship training; program documentation; recommendations; and valid, current unrestricted U.S./territory/Canada licensure. ABAI Requirements says candidates are “Board Eligible” for five years after qualifying fellowship, but ABAI About Certification says ABAI does not recognize that term and says certification must be achieved within seven years; ask ABAI—not this course—to determine individual eligibility. The course cannot replace MD/DO education, residency, fellowship, supervision, procedure experience, credentialing, licensure, or the secure examination.
